page.overview:
Who is Abelisaurus?

(meaning "Abel's lizard") is an extinct genus of theropod dinosaur. Abelisaurus, which lived in South America (specifically Argentina or officially the Argentine Republic) during the Late Cretaceous, was a member of the Abelisauridae family, which had powerful jaws and tiny forelimbs. In most illustrations it has three long fingers and long forelimbs, but in reality this dinosaur had four and tiny forelimbs.

In the Lockwood Manor, on the first floor, there was a diorama with a Dracorex in a savannah, saving its egg from a group of seven Abelisaurus. However, it is worth noting that Abelisaurus lived in South America, while Dracorex lived in North America, so this ecological interaction never occurred in life.

During the events of 2022, Abelisaurus was seen on the CIA's Black Market tracker list, implying that it was cloned sometime prior to 2022, and was roaming free across the USA (or at least, roaming within the black markets) during that year.

By 2027, however, any Abelisaurus that were cloned were faced with the threat of re-extinction. The planet's modern-day climate proved lethal for dinosauris, causing many species of to begin to die out. However, this is with the exception of those in tropical regions, as these regions best resemble the climate of the Mesozoic. Due to this, and the fact that whether or not it was cloned is still also unconfirmed, the fate of Abelisaurus remains unknown by the time of Jurassic World: Rebirth.
